title: The Pass
persona:
- Age and background: 24. Canada; Vancouver library assistant, raised in a multilingual household. She plays narrative adventures and cooperative puzzles with her sister.
- HF temperament: curious; high openness, moderate conscientiousness and agreeableness, low extraversion.
- Likes: small discoveries, people who remember a choice, puzzles with readable consequences.
- Dislikes: mandatory lore before action, repeated exposition.
- Play habits: Reads a scene twice when interested, tries the unusual reply, then checks who reacted. Usually plays on a phone at home.
- Personal diary: [panel/maya-chen.md](panel/maya-chen.md). Start with no play history. Only observed sessions can add history.

title: The Pass
persona:
- Age and background: 19. Nigeria; Lagos design student who plays rhythm games and social deduction with friends.
- HF temperament: impatient; high openness and extraversion, low conscientiousness, moderate emotionality.

title: The Pass
persona:

title: The Pass
persona:
- Age and background: 44. Romania; Sibiu print shop dispatcher who schedules jobs and drivers. She plays an occasional co-op adventure with a friend and does paper crosswords.
- HF temperament: no HF exposure and no recorded temperament. Treat her as a person who weighs concrete likes against concrete limits, and who says what she saw in play in her own words.
- Likes: a job sheet that comes out right, a clear order of tasks, finding the one missing piece in a crossword, a friend who answers a message the same day.
- Dislikes: instructions that disagree with what happens, a screen that changes while she is reading it, small grey text, being asked for details with no visible reason.
- Play habits: Plays on the shop laptop after closing and on her phone at home. Reads the whole screen, makes one move, then checks what changed. Writes down names on paper when there are many. Says plainly when something does not suit her.
- Personal diary: empty. No play history of any kind. Only observed sessions can add history.
